# 1 Enoch Chapter 49 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 49:1 — "faileth not" vs. "fails not" vs. "will never fade"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "glory-faileth-not before-him forevermore" | Archaic literal |
| LOGOS | "glory fails not before him forevermore" | Formal; retains inversion |
| PNEUMA | "his glory will never fade" | Natural English; changes subject |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Glory fails not before him forevermore" (LOGOS). The inversion is a feature of the elevated prose style of the Parables, not merely archaic. PNEUMA's "will never fade" changes "fail" to a different metaphor.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 49:3 — "spirit which gives insight" vs. "spirit of insight"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-spirit which-gives-insight" | Relative clause; Ge'ez may be participial |
| LOGOS | "the spirit which gives insight" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the spirit of insight" | Simplification |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "The spirit which gives insight" (LOGOS). The relative clause distinguishes this spirit from the others (wisdom, understanding, might) by emphasizing its active-giving function. "Of insight" collapses it into a noun phrase like the others.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 49:3 — "those who have fallen asleep in righteousness" vs. "those who have died in righteousness"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "those-who-have-fallen-asleep in-righteousness" | Literal death-sleep idiom |
| LOGOS | "those who have fallen asleep in righteousness" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "those who have died in righteousness" | Clarifies the euphemism |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Those who have fallen asleep in righteousness" (LOGOS). The sleep-death idiom is a deliberate theological expression in Jewish eschatology (cf. Dan 12:2; 1 Thess 4:14) and should be preserved, not explained away.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 3**
